uncited: **Time Complexity:** The clustering step is CPU-based and involves iterative k-means with a weighted distance calculation for each voxel and cluster.
The occlusion calculation adds a neighborhood search cost per voxel.
**Memory Complexity:** The reference volume stores one integer per voxel.
The lookup map stores $K \times n$ floats, where $K$ is the number of clusters and $n$ is the number of modalities.
**Strengths:** Reduces GPU memory footprint and sampling costs.
Limited to up to four modalities per texel fetch without offsetting complexity.
**When not to use:** Not given in the sources.
